benchmark: SearchEngine.search_tracks on the app's engine configuration
argv_note: sys.argv[1:] of python -m src.musicrec.benchmark; argv[0] is this module's absolute path on the machine and is left out

method.cpu_timer: time.thread_time_ns() around the same call; wall time well above CPU time means the process waited for a core
method.warmup: each warm-up query once before timing; not recorded
method.cold: each measured query once, order shuffled with order_seed
method.repeated: each query run repeats times back to back; the figure is statistics.median of runs 2 to repeats, the mean of the middle two runs when their count is even
method.percentile: nearest rank: sort the n values and take the one at 1-based rank ceil(p * n / 100); a cold-pass percentile is one measured call, and a repeated-pass percentile is one query's median of runs 2 to repeats
method.phase2_ran: n_exact < max_results, the condition search_tracks checks
method.results_stable: every repeated run returned the cold run's result list; a check within one process, where search is deterministic
method.result_digest: sha256 prefix of the result list (track ids, match types, scores), for comparing runs of the same query set
method.cache: the engine's similarity LRU cache is never cleared; hits and misses are cache_info() deltas around each timed call
method.gc: garbage collection stays enabled, as in the app

load_and_build_note: wall time of load_data, MusicRecommender and SearchEngine in this process, after the imports; recorded for the workflow's runtime, not a startup figure

peak_rss.scope: the whole benchmark process: catalog load, index build, searches
